notes: Makes the training-instructor option obvious via a dedicated Profile permissions control in People & Access. Adds one Head of Department (HOD) per department: HOD is selected in the person's profile and automatically becomes the Department Manager / responsible owner for the department from their Main/Default position. The database enforces one HOD per department. Multiple Supervisors remain allowed because Supervisor is a normal multi-holder position/title. Supervisors can be authorised to train by ticking Can carry out instructor-led training. The automatic Department Managers group now contains only the active HODs. Includes v2.11.57 instructor delivery logic, v2.11.55 Groups and v2.11.54 one-login/cache recovery.
